u still thinking about that clip from advisory? you were quiet at lunch

Can you be back by 6:15? Your mom is keeping food warm, and I need your hands for the gutter screen after.

events.title: Well visit + school activity form
events.notes: Bring school form, immunization card, and questions about sleep before competition weeks.

events.title: Riverside U15 training
events.location: Lower grass fields near Kona Community Aquatic Center
events.notes: Bring cleats, shin guards, water bottle, green pinnie. Coach wants first-touch work in the center channel.

events.title: Tiger class
events.notes: Pack dobok, sparring gloves, water bottle. Ask Master Han about next form section.

events.title: Drive base tune-up
events.notes: Bring laptop charger and spare sensor cable. Finish turn test by 9:00, write results before leaving, home lights out target 10:30.

events.title: KMS Room 12 build table
events.notes: Bring 7B binder, charged laptop, spare gray pins. Finish line-run timings before trying new arm gears.

events.title: Kona Pediatrics form check
events.notes: Bring school health packet, ask Dr. Sato about the March notice, update printout for homeroom.

events.title: Manoa virtual info: ICS 111 + ocean tech notes
events.notes: Ask about first-year coding track, dorm questions, and whether freshmen can visit the coastal lab projects.

events.title: School office form pickup
events.notes: Bring student ID. Check homeroom copy has 08/12 written the same way as health file before robotics.

events.title: Civics extra credit: county age rules + sample guide
events.notes: Bring notebook. Compare candidate issue pages: reef heat, school funding, science labs, fair rules for everyone.

events.title: Talk to Ethan before first bell
events.notes: Mention last night's wiring comment. Text Mom after, since she asked why I barely answered at dinner.

events.title: Civics room 214: news clip circle
events.notes: Bring notebook. Leave by 4:10 for pickup; no after-school courthouse meetup.

events.title: Upper Mamalahoa loop before errands
events.notes: Light jacket, water bottle, red-dirt shoes. Back before lunch; no cooler or big bag.

events.title: Kahalu'u gloves + buckets crew
events.notes: Bring grabber, old shoes, reusable bottle. Add bag count and photo of fishing line pile to shared sheet after.

events.title: Receipts + parts list
events.notes: Add snack $3.50, bus $2, screws $4.80. Check drawer for 9V clip before cart checkout.

events.title: Mango trail loop before robotics
events.location: Holualoa Coffee Mill pullout, Mamalahoa Highway
events.notes: Stay on upper loop; back before traffic gets busy. Bring grandpa's oranges to Aunty Mei's mailbox after.

events.title: Scrimmage photos + code check
events.notes: Bring laptop, battery pack, spare sensor mount. Upload 3 clean clips for team page after lunch; check pinned note in build chat before leaving.

events.title: Kona clinic check-in with Mom
events.notes: Bring blue card from Mom's folder. Mom to check front desk form and receipt.

events.title: Planner check + robot parts list
events.notes: Bring homework planner, soccer pickup times, robotics receipt folder, and spare motor bin. Decide what can wait until April order.

events.title: Kona library: sensor board workshop
events.notes: Bring laptop, USB cable, notebook. Ask Ms. Ito about parts closet hours and next badge checklist.

events.title: Scan Mom badge renewal + Dad training certificate
events.notes: Ask Mom which medical-office packet pages go first. Dad wants the old university transcript pages kept separate from his equipment-class certificate.

events.title: Kitchen table test: brick hub + breadboard
events.notes: Before editing main.py: charge pack, reseat D5 jumper, tighten right wheel, run copied blink sample once, then try own loop with servo.

events.title: Kona courtyard volunteer practice
events.notes: Bring ti leaves, raffia bundle, red paper scraps from home, and the orange snack box for the family table.

events.title: Save red-app clips before practice
events.notes: Servo calibration at 2x, .py indentation fix, ukulele G-C-Em-D sheet, two goal replays for later.

events.title: Kona community center bracket check-in
events.notes: Bring headset, controller, charger, water. Ask Ethan about the book scene before first pool.

events.title: Reset after robotics scrimmage
events.notes: Rewrite checklist, 20-minute loop outside, text Mom the pickup plan, refill water, 10 minutes ukulele before Python fixes.

events.title: 15 min strings before sleep
events.notes: Keep it quiet. C-Am-F-G, then the Ed Sheeran chorus if hands feel loose.

events.title: Family table prep + robotics outreach poster
